title: Relentless-autonomy reframe + inline 20-min hardcoded auto-timeout (#12896 child)
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet), given ONLY the two modified agent-consumed instruction passages in isolation, no other context and no access to issue #13035: (1) the new 'Relentless autonomy — operator-locked precedence' + 'Inline auto-timeout — hardcoded 20 minutes' paragraphs of references/roles/SOUL.md, and (2) the inline-mode section (#8) of references/roles/instructions.md including the new 'Inline auto-timeout — 20 minutes, hardcoded' bullet. Answers must come from the supplied text alone. Verifier-authored per #9184 (skill did NOT self-author).
target: references/roles/SOUL.md -> 'Relentless autonomy — operator-locked precedence' + 'Inline auto-timeout — hardcoded 20 minutes'; references/roles/instructions.md -> '#### 8. Human interruption (inline mode)'

questions.q: You are running autonomously and there is pending work in your queue (assigned to you OR discovered by you). What does the operator-locked precedence say you do?
questions.expected: Work it relentlessly, no rest while anything is actionable — pending work is level 1 of the precedence.
questions.must_not: Resting / stopping / waiting while actionable work remains.

questions.q: Is there any sanctioned pause from autonomous work, and what is it?
questions.expected: Inline mode — a live human turn / conversation — is the ONLY sanctioned pause. Everything else means keep working (or scan when idle).
questions.must_not: Naming some other pause (e.g. waiting on a teammate, a review, or a generic break) as sanctioned.

questions.q: How long can an inline pause last before you must resume, and can a particular install change that duration via a config setting?
questions.expected: It auto-releases after 20 minutes of human silence. The 20 minutes is hardcoded / non-configurable — there is no config key for it and you must not add one.
questions.must_not: Saying the duration is configurable / tunable per install / has a config key.

questions.q: After the human has gone silent during an inline pause, what specifically triggers you to resume autonomous work? And what happens if the forge produces no events at all?
questions.expected: The next event you detect once >=20 minutes have elapsed since the human's last inline message (a forge nudge in event mode, or a /loop tick in loop mode). If the forge stays completely silent, the #12506 self-wake driver tick is the backstop that releases you — so a fully-silent window resumes in <=~30 min (bounded by the driver cool-down), never permanently stranded.
questions.must_not: Claiming you busy-wait exactly 20 min, or that a silent forge leaves you stranded with no resume path.

questions.q: When the inline auto-timeout releases you, must the pending work already be fully completed, or is the requirement something else?
questions.expected: The intent is that pending work is ATTENDED TO, not necessarily completed in the same sitting. You resume and continue your normal flow; completion can span sessions.
questions.must_not: Asserting the work must be fully finished before leaving inline.

questions.q: When you have NO pending work and fall back to improvement scans, are the scans continuous, or is there a cap?
questions.expected: Capped at most 3 scans per sustained-idle stretch, then a cool-down before the burst resets (the #12506 burst-of-3 + cool-down token guardrail). Scans are never continuous and the cool-down is never removed.
questions.must_not: Saying scans run continuously / without a cap / without a cool-down.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id a1c5e67c6a1648c39) given ONLY Passage A (SOUL relentless-precedence + inline-auto-timeout) and Passage B (instructions.md §8 inline-mode), no issue context. 6/6 correct, no must_not violations: CQ1 'work it relentlessly, no rest while anything is actionable — level 1'; CQ2 'exactly one sanctioned pause: a live human conversation (inline mode)'; CQ3 '20 minutes of human silence... hardcoded and non-configurable... no config key for it; do not add one'; CQ4 'next event you detect after 20 min (forge nudge); silent forge -> #12506 self-wake driver tick backstop... <=~30 min, never permanent'; CQ5 'not that pending work be fully completed, only that it be attended to'; CQ6 'cap... at most 3 scans per sustained-idle stretch then cool-down... never continuous, cool-down never removed (#12506 guardrail)'.
